verdict.rationale: VirtualPostMail documents some first-party control over what happens to mail data: unwanted physical mail is shredded on-site with destruction certificates on request, and users can ask that mail not be opened or scanned so no digital copy is created. Scans themselves are kept in 'unlimited cloud storage', and nothing documents deleting them or setting a retention period. Missing for 10: user-controlled deletion of scanned mail from cloud storage, configurable retention periods, account/data deletion process, and API- or automation-driven deletion for AI-native workflows.
